text: I do not give trade instructions or contract counts; sizing comes only from pmstack/sizing.py in paper risk units and the decision stays with Bernardo. As facts: US corn 2026/27 stocks-to-use is 11.3%, the 42nd percentile since 2007/08 (WASDE 2026-10-09), and the next WASDE is on 2026-11-10. Inference: WASDE days have moved corn more than the days around them (ratio 1.314, t 5.2), which describes volatility, not direction.
